sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
Correct's core gameplay mechanics are centered around guessing which hair contains the ball. The game features a series of hairs, each with a unique color and design, and the ball moves randomly from one hair to another. Players must predict which hair the ball will move to next, with each correct guess rewarding them with points and increasing their chances of achieving a high score. The game features a variety of gameplay modes, including a timed mode where players must guess as many hairs as possible within a set time limit, and a free-play mode where players can play at their own pace.

One of the key features of Correct's gameplay mechanics is its use of timing and prediction. Players must accurately predict which hair the ball will move to next, taking into account factors such as the ball's previous movement and the design of the hairs. This requires players to develop a keen sense of timing and prediction, as well as the ability to think on their feet and make quick decisions. The game also features a variety of power-ups and bonuses, including multipliers and bonuses for consecutive correct guesses.

Correct's gameplay mechanics are designed to be intuitive and easy to learn, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels. However, the game's increasing difficulty and challenging gameplay mechanics ensure that players will be kept on their toes and motivated to improve their skills. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just looking for a fun way to pass the time, Correct's core gameplay mechanics are sure to provide hours of entertainment and challenge.
